items.label: 【13 PACKS SEA CREATURES NO HOLE BATH TOYS FOR KIDS】
items.value: Use rubber, no hole and easy to clean. We provide random 12 kinds of sea animal toys (10 color changing toys and 2 glow in the dark toys) with a color changing bath book for kids. Suitable as water toys, bath toys, bathtub toys, squeeze toys, bathroom pool toys, animal toys, party favors, stocking stuffers, Goody Bag Fillers, Classroom Prizes and Pinata Fillers.

items.label: 【COLOR CHANGING TOYS】
items.value: 10 packs of sea creatures toys magically change colors in warm water above 33℃. The bath book can magically change color and come in different patterns when it exposed to water. Vivid designs and magical skills will be a big surprise for kids.

items.label: 【GLOW IN THE DARK】
items.value: We extra have lanternfish and sea horse which are glowing in the dark. The more direct light they absorbed, the more obvious effect of glowing in the dark.

items: 【SOFT & STRECHY】Also perform as stress relief toys. Endless fun to stretch, twist and squeeze these sea creature toys.

items.label: 【HIGH QUALITY AND SAFETY】
items.value: All toys meet US safety standards (ASTM & CPSIA). Please rest assured to buy and enjoy these sea animal toys.
